title: Bathroom mount
summary: A holder or shelf for a wet room: tile, glass or a painted wall.

questions.label: What it holds
questions.placeholder: e.g. a shampoo bottle, a razor, a toothbrush cup
questions.why: The held object defines the pocket and the load.

questions.label: Object width
questions.why: Measured envelope of the object sets the holder size.

questions.label: Object depth
questions.why: Sets how far the holder stands off the wall.

questions.label: Object mass when full
questions.why: Sets the peel load on adhesive or the screw load.

questions.label: Fixing
questions.why: Adhesive needs a flat rear bonding face; screws need holes in the wall and tool access.

questions.label: Wall surface
questions.why: Adhesive strength and grout lines depend on the surface.

questions.label: Water exposure
questions.why: Standing water needs drainage; direct spray rules out some materials.

load.note: Held object plus water, applied for months.

material.why: Tolerates water and warm showers better than PLA; still creeps under sustained load.
material.consider: Check that cleaning products do not attack the filament.

checks.name: Mounting load path
checks.why: The load goes into the wall as shear, not as peel on the adhesive.

checks.name: Drainage and cleaning
checks.why: No pocket holds standing water; every surface can be wiped.

checks.name: Bonding area or fixing access
checks.why: Enough flat area for the pad, or room for a screwdriver.

checks.name: Material exposure
checks.why: Heat, water and cleaning chemicals are within what the filament tolerates.
